title: Sequential Awaits
prompt: Implement async def flow() that awaits two steps in order: step_one() returns 1 (after sleeping 0.01), step_two(n) returns n + 1 (after sleeping 0.01); flow returns step_two(step_one's result) — i.e. 2. Provide a sync run_flow() wrapper using asyncio.run.
boilerplate:
import asyncio

async def step_one():
    pass

async def step_two(n):
    pass

async def flow():
    pass

def run_flow():
    pass

tests.name: value flows through steps
tests.hint: second = await step_one(); return await step_two(second).

tests.name: steps are coroutines
tests.code:
import inspect
assert inspect.iscoroutinefunction(step_one)
assert inspect.iscoroutinefunction(step_two)
